source: data/derived/zip-governments.json, joined to public/geo/*.geojson by GEOID
sourceOrg: U.S. Census Bureau (TIGER) via this repo's own lattice sampling
scope: zips whose ZCTA sits in state FIPS 04, 33, 34 — the states this repo has committed geometry for. A zip absent from this file is outside OUR committed geometry and the consumer falls back to the centroid answer; absence here is never a claim about a place.
note: Every division whose TERRITORY overlaps the zip's area. NOT a claim that a reader at this zip votes in all of them — a ZCTA crosses jurisdiction lines, which is why anything surfaced from this renders with the jurisdiction it belongs to printed beside it.
partialNote: Divisions covering only PART of this zip's area, measured on a 0.01-degree lattice. An id present in `zips` and absent here covers every sampled point of the ZCTA. The zip total is the sum of its county-layer samples: counties tile the country with no gaps or overlaps, checked across all 33,791 zips in the national source before being relied on. A zip with no county edge has every division marked partial rather than any called certain.
